lines: Ye shaam ka taara jise tum chhor gayi ho
couplets.en: You left this evening star behind.
In the desert of love, it marks where the heart grieves.

lines: Dil bujh gaya ya jalti rahi sham-e-tamanna
couplets.en: Did the heart go dark, or did the candle of longing burn on?

lines: Kehte hi nahin hum ke na jao
couplets.en: I never ask you to stay.

lines: Tum chal diye rangon mein basi shaam ke hamrah
couplets.en: You went away with the evening still full of color.
The beloved's country is gone.
The waiting for the beloved is over.
The beloved's country is gone.
The love of so many years is gone.
The beloved's country is gone.

lines: Woh jis ke husn mein shokhi thi mauj-e-darya ki
couplets.en: A river wave's playfulness lived in that beauty.

lines: Woh ruk ke hum se mila aur gaya
couplets.en: They paused to meet me, then went away.
That air of grace is gone.
The love of so many years is gone.
The beloved's country is gone.

lines: Woh mera dost, mera aashna, mera mehboob
couplets.en: My friend, my confidant, my beloved.

lines: Woh jis ke saath mohabbat ka karobar gaya
couplets.en: With them went all the quiet dealings of love.
The beloved's country is gone.
The love of so many years is gone.
The beloved's country is gone.

lines: Woh tund-khu, woh mera mehrban sitamgar
couplets.en: My quick-tempered love, as tender as they were cruel.
Gone is the one who gave me peace and took it away.
The beloved's country is gone.
The love of so many years is gone.
The beloved's country is gone.

lines: Bas ek baar woh aaya aur us pe ye andaaz
couplets.en: They came just once, and came with such an air.

lines: Ke jaise aaya nahin aur hazaar baar gaya
couplets.en: It was as if they had never come and had left a thousand times.
The beloved's country is gone.
The love of so many years is gone.
The beloved's country is gone.
How can I speak to my own of being parted from the beloved?

lines: Na jin ka yaar gaya, na jin ka pyaar gaya
couplets.en: They have yet to lose a beloved or a love.
That air of grace is gone.
The love of so many years is gone.
The beloved's country is gone.
The waiting for the beloved is over.
That air of grace is gone.
The love of so many years is gone.
The beloved's country is gone.
